t: You're looking at numbers 77 to 109 Onslow Square, a building in Kensington and Chelsea, in the SW7 postcode. The person linked to it is Dame Adelaide Doughty, who died here in 1986. Born in 1908, she was an Australian-born political figure who made her life in Britain, and is described as an Australian-British politician. The material I have is brief, so that is the connection to this address.
